items.title: How Bullish 2026 Earnings Forecasts At EOG Resources (EOG) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Wall Street analysts recently projected that EOG Resources’ June 2026 quarter earnings per share would more than double year over year, with revenues expected to reach about US$7.95 billion on strong contributions from crude oil, natural gas liquids, and gathering, processing, and marketing. Beyond the headline growth, shifting analyst expectations and segment-by-segment optimism highlight how EOG’s diversified production mix is increasingly central to its earnings power.
